title: FlapLab Daily — 456 Launches a Year.exe
story: You are Starship. SpaceX wants 456 launches a year out of Boca Chica — nearly one every weekday. Hold to thrust: the Mechazilla towers keep popping up and nobody has time to stack you twice.
inspiration: FAA opened its environmental review on 14 Oct 2026 for SpaceX's plan to go from 25 to up to 456 Starship launches (912 landings) a year at Starbase — the Squid Game number did the rest; then Texas officials floated selling Boca Chica State Park to SpaceX (X Trending 2110366824164622407, 14 Oct; 2111315193347055863, 17 Oct). Starship SN16 + Starbase launch tower + Boca Chica site photos (Wikimedia), rembg cutouts. Fly mode = hold-to-thrust rocket.
